title: Gmail & Telegram
description: Let the assistant read your own email and messages to summarize, remind and draft replies. Read + drafts only — the assistant never sends anything for you.

privacy.title: Privacy
points: You create your own OAuth client (Google) and api_id (Telegram) — the app never shares keys.
Secrets, tokens and sessions stay on this computer, encrypted by Windows (DPAPI).
The assistant reads only when a question needs it, at most 60 times/hour per service; reading doesn't mark anything as read.
Every draft is shown to you to review / edit first; you send it yourself in Gmail / Telegram.
Verification-code, bank and sensitive chats are hidden by default; Telegram service messages (login codes) are always blocked.

gmail.enableHelp: The assistant searches and reads mail and proposes reply drafts. Turn off any time.
gmail.setupTitle: How to create an OAuth client (once, ~5 min)
setup: Open console.cloud.google.com and create a new project (e.g. "MMC studio personal").
OAuth consent screen: choose External, fill in app name + your email; under Test users add your own Gmail address.
Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID → Application type: Desktop app.
Paste the Client ID and Client secret below, click Save, then click Connect Gmail.
gmail.waiting: Waiting for you to sign in in the browser…
gmail.previewHelp: Shown locally only, not sent to the assistant. Struck-through mail is hidden from the assistant.
gmail.expired: Your Google sign-in expired (OAuth apps in Testing mode only stay signed in for 7 days). Click Reconnect.
gmail.expiresIn_one: Google will ask you to sign in again in about {{count}} day (Testing mode).
gmail.expiresIn_other: Google will ask you to sign in again in about {{count}} days (Testing mode).
gmail.skipSensitiveHelp: Verification / OTP codes, password resets, bank and payment mail are never given to the assistant.
gmail.testingMode: OAuth app is in Testing mode
gmail.testingModeHelp: Google signs you out after 7 days; the app will remind you to reconnect.
gmail.blockedHelp: One address or domain per line. Mail from these is never given to the assistant.

telegram.enableHelp: Sign in with your Telegram account. The assistant only reads chats you allow and saves draft messages.
setup: Open my.telegram.org and sign in with your Telegram phone number.
Choose "API development tools" and create an app (any name, platform: Desktop).
Paste api_id and api_hash below and click Save.
Enter your phone number → Telegram sends a code to your Telegram app → enter it (and your 2FA password if set).
telegram.codeHelp: Telegram just sent a code to your Telegram app (or SMS). Never share this code.
telegram.passwordHelp: Your account has two-step verification. The password is only used to sign in and is not stored.

modeHelp.allowlist: Tick the chats the assistant may read. None by default.
modeHelp.blocklist: Untick to block. Sensitive chats (bank, wallet, OTP) are blocked by default — tick to allow.

telegram.sensitiveHelp: Looks like a bank / wallet / verification-code chat.
telegram.lockedHelp: Telegram service messages contain login codes — never readable by the assistant.

hint.gmail: Edit if needed. The draft is only saved to Gmail → Drafts; open Gmail to send it yourself.
hint.telegram: Edit if needed. The text is only saved into the chat's input box (replacing any old draft); press send yourself in Telegram.

errors.not_configured: Enter and save the details above first.
errors.access_denied: You declined access in the browser.
errors.timeout: Sign-in not finished within 5 minutes — try again.
errors.port_in_use: Sign-in port 47823 is busy (maybe a team sign-in is running). Try again later.
errors.state_mismatch: Sign-in response didn't match — try again.
errors.no_refresh_token: Google didn't return a long-lived token. Remove the app at myaccount.google.com/permissions and reconnect.
errors.logout_first: Log out of Telegram before changing api_id.
errors.code_expired: Code expired — send a new one.
errors.no_account: This number has no Telegram account.
errors.no_login: Sign-in was cancelled — start again from the phone number.
errors.session_revoked: Your Telegram session was logged out from another device — sign in again.
errors.invalid_input: Input is not in the right format.
